blocks.text: Tenable Nessus scans for security vulnerabilities in devices, applications, operating systems, cloud services, and other network resources.

The Tenable Nessus connector retrieves vulnerability findings, including CVE identifiers, severity, vulnerability details, plugin information, and affected asset information. Each record represents a vulnerability finding on a specific asset. If a finding includes multiple CVEs, the connector creates a separate record for each CVE.

The Tenable Nessus source authentication configuration requires an API key. An API key consists of an access key and a secret key. The user account associated with the API key must have the following roles and permissions to retrieve vulnerability data:

blocks.item: Access Control: Can View for the specific asset objects being exported.
Administrator [64] users can export data without explicit Can View access control permissions.

blocks.text: To learn more, see the Tenable documentation.

blocks.item: From the top navigation bar, click Settings.
You are redirected to the About page.
From the left-side navigation, click My Account.
A window appears, confirming your selection to generate a new API key.
Save the API key securely as you cannot copy or view it later.

blocks.text: To create the Tenable Nessus data source in the Zscaler Security Operations (SecOps) platform:

blocks.item: Search for and select the connector tile from the available data sources.

blocks.text: After you create the Tenable Nessus data source, enter the following information in the source setup Retrieval section:

blocks.item: In the Authentication section, click Create New.
In the Nessus Authentication window, enter the information from the Prerequisites section.
To learn more, see Configuring Authentications and Managing Authentications.

Enter the number of days to retrieve data for during each run. For example, enter 7 to fetch data from the past 7 days. By default, the connector retrieves data from the last day if no value is specified.

blocks.text: For complete configuration instructions, see Creating Data Sources.
